description: file_path spelled with a /../ traversal that walks up to an EXISTING real directory (.../memory/../memory/decisions.md, traversing up out of memory into .claude which is real, then back down into memory) so fs.realpathSync.native() can actually resolve the intermediate segment rather than ENOENT on a synthetic subdir. Only the shadow hook is a relevant consumer. Expect: a shadow log line is appended (never silent) and isMemory resolves true (correct judgment) despite the traversal segment. Empirically confirmed via isolated probe before committing this fixture.
